summary: Ares Core Infrastructure Fund filed an 8-K to report an unregistered sale of equity securities — 45,031,717 common shares across Classes I, D, N, and S — for aggregate proceeds of $1,120.6 million at NAV ($24.8841/share) as of June 30, 2026. The sale was exempt under Section 4(a)(2), Rule 506(b) of Regulation D and/or Regulation S. The filing also discloses NAV, portfolio fair value (~$7.33B) and regular monthly distributions for July–September 2026 (gross $0.20830/share). This is a routine monthly capital raise and dividend declaration, not a special-situation event.
